Messages.Author: Orpheus
Messages.Body:
Agaitas : Sabbat: Whenever you play a card, you may draw its replacement
from your prey's library instead of your own. Put the card drawn face-up in
front of you. It is still considered to be in your hand, to be played or
discarded as normal.

Semsith : Political Action - Worth 1 Vote. Called by any vampire at +1
stealth.
Choose another Methuselah. If this referendum is successful, put this card
in play. Your hand size is one card smaller. The chosen Methuselah doesn't
draw to replace cards during any Methuselah's minion phase. After each
minion phase, he or she draws back up to his or her hand size. Any vampire
may call a referendum to burn this card as a +1 stealth political action.

My question is : if you are the target of a Meddling, and you control
Agaitas, can you replace the cards (at the end of your minion phase) from
your prey's hand ?

Messages.Author: Trey Morita
Messages.Body:
On Thu, 18 Jul 2002 00:56:35 +0200, "Orpheus" <orph...@wanadoo.fr> wrote:
> Semsith : Political Action - Worth 1 Vote. Called by any vampire at +1
> stealth.
> Choose another Methuselah. If this referendum is successful, put this card
> in play. Your hand size is one card smaller. The chosen Methuselah doesn't
> draw to replace cards during any Methuselah's minion phase. After each
> minion phase, he or she draws back up to his or her hand size. Any vampire
> may call a referendum to burn this card as a +1 stealth political action.
>
> My question is : if you are the target of a Meddling, and you control
> Agaitas, can you replace the cards (at the end of your minion phase) from
> your prey's hand ?

It looks like from the way Semsith is worded, the cards you play during a
minion phase are never replaced. It depends on whether the "end of minion
phase, draw up to hand size" is considered a delayed replacement of the
cards you played during the minion phase. Either way you would never replace
from your prey's HAND.

So either:

A) When Meddled, cards you play during a minion phase are never replaced,
but you draw up to hand size at the end of a minion phase.

or

B) When Meddled, cards you play during a minion phase are replaced at the
end of that minion phase.

B requires a leap of logic not supported by card text, I think.

If A is true, as I suspect, then the cards you draw at the end of a minion
phase are unaffected by Agaitas' special, since they are not part of the
"play a card, replace it" mechanic, which is what Agaitas' special affects.

Trey

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No. Agaitas's ability only functions when you play the card. If the replacement
doesn't occur at that point, then you don't get to use his ability.
